summary.text: Jane English represents District 13 in the Arkansas Senate, which includes parts of North Little Rock and northern Pulaski County, and was sworn into the Senate in January 2013.

paragraphs.text: She served two terms in the Arkansas House of Representatives, from 2009 through the end of 2012.

A native of Lincoln, Nebraska, English graduated from Arkansas Tech University with a bachelor's degree in economics/finance and worked in economic development, including 13 years at the Arkansas Economic Development Commission starting in 1984.
